description.html: The red-green artificial plant with small leaves has an upright, dense stem lined with alternating small red and green leaves. It stands on a light-colored base, so you simply set it on the bottom.

The advantage of an artificial plant is that it looks the same day after day: it does not rot, lose leaves or need strong lighting or fertilizer. It does not affect water parameters, and fish use it as cover, especially younger and shyer ones.

Because of its height and density, it looks best along the back glass or in the corners, where it forms a green and red backdrop for the fish. Several in a row give the impression of a densely planted aquarium. When algae appear on the leaves, take the plant out, rinse it under lukewarm water and brush it with a soft brush. Do not use chemical cleaners, as residues can end up in the water. Browse our other decorations and equipment.
